name: Bulwark Webmail (self-hosted)
free_limit: AGPL-3.0-only self-hosted webmail client for Stalwart Mail Server: JMAP mail, calendar, contacts, files, inbox search, templates and scheduled sending; no vendor-imposed client seat or usage quota documented.
watch_out: Requires a separately deployed compatible Stalwart Mail Server (0.16.6+ per upstream), server resources, domain/TLS and mail delivery configuration; does not include free email hosting or outbound mail capacity. AGPL-3.0 obligations apply, including special provisional app-store distribution permission; review upstream LICENSE. Verify deployment/security before production.
